order: Fix all four findings from the latest cross-vendor review round and record its verdict. Make the touches lint compare path elements rather than a collision-prone comma join. Have the deep-plan glob matcher reproduce the retired regular expression's line-terminator classes exactly. Give the checkout module a startup sweep that reclaims abandoned worktrees whose directories still exist, since pruning alone only clears registrations whose directory is already gone; checkouts this process is actively using must stay exempt. Correct the review-order wording so a future order enumerates every commit in its pinned range instead of describing the range as a single commit. Record the review verdict verbatim in the roster, keep the tranche at REVISE pending the next round, and leave the suites green.
claims: All four findings are addressed: element-wise comparison in the touches lint, exact line-terminator classes in the glob matcher, a startup sweep that reclaims abandoned worktrees left on disk with active ones exempt, and a review-order wording fix. The verdict is recorded verbatim in the roster. The suites re-ran green, with the router at 135 passed, verifier at 94 passed, and registry at 31 passed.
